lexicon/tibetan-butter-sculpture-1.alt_en: Tibetan butter sculpture in red, blue, yellow and white: a grey-haired woman holds a lantern at a lighthouse door, framed by modelled flowers and scrolls.

problems: Border of lotus blossoms and scrolls in saturated red, blue, green, yellow and white is convincing butter relief
Central sky and sea lean toward impasto paint and a somewhat generic sunset; woman reads like a painted figurine
Monastery hall / butter-lamp setting not shown (panel fills the frame)
lexicon/tibetan-butter-sculpture-2.alt_de: Tibetische Butterskulptur in wachsig glänzendem Relief: Eine grauhaarige Frau mit Besen steht in der Leuchtturmtür, daneben Hund und Ruderboot, gerahmt von bunten Lotosblüten und Ranken.
lexicon/tibetan-butter-sculpture-2.alt_en: Tibetan butter sculpture in waxy relief: a grey-haired woman with a broom and her dog in a lighthouse doorway, framed by colourful lotuses and scrolls.

problems: No alphabets, numerals, weight rows, hero glyph, size labels or specimen grid: the image is a generic vintage travel poster with a big serif title
Text is correct: 'LORNHOLM', '1 Ferry', '2 Lighthouse', '3 Market' legible and spelled right; blank chalkboard, no filler text
Structural conflict: the style needs specimen text but the info motif forbids any extra text; a retry would need e.g. the letters of LORNHOLM displayed as specimen glyphs and weights
lexicon/type-specimen-sheet-1.note_de: Statt eines Schriftmusterblatts mit Alphabeten, Schnitten und Größenangaben zeigt das Bild ein gewöhnliches Reiseplakat.
lexicon/type-specimen-sheet-1.note_en: Instead of a type specimen with alphabets, weights and size labels, the image shows an ordinary travel poster.
lexicon/type-specimen-sheet-1.alt_de: Illustriertes Reiseplakat mit großem Serifentitel LORNHOLM über einer Insel, darunter nummeriert Fähre, Leuchtturm und Marktstand, verbunden durch eine gestrichelte Route.
lexicon/type-specimen-sheet-1.alt_en: Illustrated travel poster with a large serif title LORNHOLM above an island, with a numbered ferry, lighthouse and market stall linked by a dashed route.

problems: Arabic-style letterforms are demanded by the fragment; they appear to be asemic pseudo-script rather than meaningful text (acceptable per rules, worth knowing)
Script shapes lighthouse, dog, gulls, boat, rocks and sea, but the woman's face and hands are conventionally drawn; her sweater is only patterned with script
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-1.note_de: Schrift formt Leuchtturm, Hund und Möwen, doch Gesicht und Hände der Frau sind gewöhnlich gezeichnet statt aus Buchstaben gebildet.
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-1.note_en: Script shapes the lighthouse, dog and gulls, but the woman's face and hands are conventionally drawn rather than built from letters.
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-1.alt_de: Figurale Kalligrafie in Schwarz und Gold mit blauer Ornamentbordüre: Arabische Schriftzüge formen Leuchtturm, Möwen, Hund und Boot; eine grauhaarige Frau hält eine Laterne hoch.
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-1.alt_en: Figural calligraphy in black and gold with blue illuminated border: Arabic-style letterforms shape the lighthouse, gulls, dog and boat; a grey-haired woman raises a lantern.

problems: Woman and dog are drawn conventionally, not formed from letterforms; calligraphy serves as texture fill in tower, rocks, boat and sea rather than building the silhouettes
Script appears to be pseudo-Arabic rather than legible thuluth (text-like elements are demanded by the fragment, but garbled)
Gold-flecked paper and illuminated rumi corner ornaments are present
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-2.note_de: Die Schriftzüge füllen Leuchtturm, Felsen und Boot nur als Muster, Frau und Hund sind gewöhnlich gezeichnet, und die Schrift ist arabisch anmutende Fantasieschrift.
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-2.note_en: The script only fills the lighthouse, rocks and boat as pattern, the woman and dog are drawn conventionally, and the lettering is pseudo-Arabic.
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-2.alt_de: Kalligrafie in Schwarz und Gold mit Ornamentrand: Eine grauhaarige Frau mit Besen und Hund steht in der Leuchtturmtür; Turm, Felsen und Boot bestehen aus Schriftzügen.
lexicon/zoomorphic-calligraphy-2.alt_en: Black-and-gold calligraphy with illuminated border: a grey-haired woman with broom and dog stands in a lighthouse doorway; tower, rocks and boat are built from script.
